big_messages.label: Conversion
big_messages.text: “Extremely bullish on mining conversion — forged to high-chrome, copper/gold/iron, Chile + Peru — aiming +30-40k tonnes sales every year.”

big_messages.label: Solutions
big_messages.text: “Only company offering grinding media + metal + rubber/composite liners under one roof — process optimisation, not price competition.”

big_messages.label: Resilience
big_messages.text: “FY25 sales −12% on volume/shipments, yet PAT −6.5% only — core OPM ~28% — pricing power with 3-6 month pass-through.”

bottom_line.core_idea: Not a foundry — grinding-productivity platform (media + liners + diaphragms + service) sold on cost-per-tonne, not price-per-kg.
bottom_line.hidden_insight: Watch volume MT × export realisation — 30-40k t/year growth at 28% OPM funds the multiple; treasury (~₹487 Cr other income) flatters PAT.
bottom_line.open_question: Convert mines at 30-40k t/year while holding 28% OPM through duties, freight and ferrochrome cycles?
bottom_line.takeaway: Don't pay 28x for castings — own conversion, wait price near AlphaSpread buy zone ₹2,432.
bottom_line.what_breaks: Volumes flat + debtors >120 days + ADD/CVD spread → OPM <25% → P/E 28x compresses toward 20x.
bottom_line.what_changed: Cement domestic → global mining conversion — 65% export, 140 countries, liners now double-digit volume share.

financial_snapshot.note: TTM to Jun-26 (Screener consol) — conversion growth vs premium: Sales +6% TTM on 28% OPM. ROCE 21.1% at 28x.

forecast.note: Shares flat at ~9.33 Cr (FV ₹2) — ₹4,200 Cr cash, no dilution assumed. Bear = duties + destocking + derate to 20x. Base = AlphaSpread DCF (8% Rev, 22.2% margin, 11.3%, 24.5x) → ₹4,212 (+1.9% CAGR). Bull = conversion surge + integrated liners, P/E held at 28x. Current P/E 28.3x; base derates to 24.5x — volumes must do work.

valuation.methodology: AlphaSpread DCF — 10-year forecast via Net Income, Revenue Growth 8.0% (vs 5Y hist 8.9%, Wall St 4Y 9.6%), Net Margin 25.9%→22.2% (vs 5Y 23.2%, Wall St 22.9%), Discount Rate 11.3% (Cost of Equity 11.25% = Rf 6.95% + Beta 1 × ERP 4.3%; WACC 11.16%), Exit Multiple 24.5x P/E. Multiples-Based Value from P/E, P/S, P/OCF, P/B, EV/Sales/EBITDA/EBIT etc. vs peers/history. Intrinsic Value = AlphaSpread selected method (DCF for AIA). Wall St target ₹4,775.64 sits above market — the bull case.
